measured_code: A2 and A3 paths in the same frozen clean build; measurement harness gets its own clean local commit before execution. Record commit/tree and application-source fingerprint. No source changes mid-study.

workloads.recipe: For physical row i=1..N: every i divisible by37 repeats the exact preceding normalized Candle, without sequence advance. Otherwise increment consumed index j, choose stream (j-1)%16 and increment that stream's sequence. Baselines1; source synthetic, epoch bench, instruments S00..S15, timestamp2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. Price=100000+j%100, high=price+2, low=price-2, close=price+1, volume=j%300. Consumed j divisible by17 has open=price+3 (bad OHLC). UTF8/LF.
workloads.expected_counts: duplicate=floor(N/37), consumed=N-duplicate, badOHLC=floor(consumed/17), accepted=consumed-badOHLC, quarantine=duplicate+badOHLC. Only VALID_RECORD/OHLC_INCONSISTENT/DUPLICATE_IN_WINDOW primary reasons.
workloads.interpretation: No permanent gap/conflict blocks in these throughput inputs. Stress uses the same recipe at250k once per variant. This is an end-to-end mode comparison including writer/flush/checkpoint differences, not an isolated causal checkpoint speedup.

finite_schedule.measured: For each regular size, three rounds in fixed order A2â†’A3, A3â†’A2, A2â†’A3 (12 measured children).
finite_schedule.hash_reference: One separately labelled file-SHA256-only reference per size. Never subtract or call it actual in-run phase duration.
finite_schedule.warmup_scope: Every worker is a fresh process. Warmup can affect filesystem cache; it does not carry JIT state. Startup/JIT are still included.
finite_schedule.cache_scope: No cache eviction, affinity or host isolation. Generation and untimed output verification may warm caches.

methods.parent_wall: Python perf_counter_ns immediately before child launch through exit, including startup and metric collection; excludes build/generation.
methods.operation_wall: Stopwatch.GetTimestamp directly around complete SequenceValidator.Run or RecoveryRunner.Start, including manifest parse, pre/post hashes, reads, writes, flushes and checkpoints.
methods.collection_order: Create Process stats handle/initial CPU; allocation0=GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(true); t0; validate; t1; allocation1; Refresh/CPU1/PeakWorkingSet64; serialize metrics.
methods.allocation: Whole-process cumulative managed allocation delta around operation, including runtime threads and stated counter overhead. Not retained heap or peak memory.
methods.cpu: CPU delta collection window is slightly wider than operation wall, including stats reads; wall and CPU separate.
methods.peak_memory: OS/runtime Process.PeakWorkingSet64 for the entire fresh worker lifetime including startup/JIT; not sampled current working set or managed heap peak. Zero/unsupported is UNKNOWN.
methods.throughput: All physical records N / operation seconds; source bytes / operation seconds. Never accepted records as denominator.
methods.summary: Three regular measured samples: min/median/max only. Stress one observation per variant. No p95/p99/SLA/HFT/production/profit claims.

guards: Check independent recipe count formulas on every completed worker.
Record all three canonical hashes and streaming-byte-compare each completed output against that size's A2 reference.
Verify clean Git state and app/harness/protocol source hashes before/after study; mutations invalidate study.
Hash source/manifest before execution and after study; no timing-driven edits or retuning.

resources.scope: One identified local Windows host first. Linux correctness CI is separate from performance; no cross-OS ranking.
resources.reservation: Before each child reserve N*2048+4MiB summary+1MiB metrics/log; A3 additionally3*(64MiB+52) for two slots plus pending. Include current actual artifacts. Stop before launch if reservation would exceed2GiB. Fresh starts only, no evidence-vault growth or fault hooks during measurement.
resources.enforcement: One owned child at a time, remaining global deadline as hard timeout, scoped cleanup. Check actual bytes after each step. Failed/incomplete artifacts retained.
resources.stop: First timeout, resource limit, unexpected exit, output/counter mismatch, source mutation or invalid metric stops the remaining schedule with an incomplete/invalid receipt. No retry or smaller substitute workload.

private: Resolved executable/cwd and literal machine-specific argv remain in private launch receipt
environment.commands: Public receipt labels a portable source-relative command plus executable version/hash. Literal resolved paths are private, not falsely called unredacted public argv.

delivery.flow: After A3 acceptance/release, freeze local measurement-code commit; execute only on protocol approval. Prepare A5 from immutable samples, then one exact-tree final release for A4+A5. Measured ancestor commit stays accessible; final docs/results commit is distinguished from measured code.
delivery.public_allowlist: Fresh recipe/harness/protocol, compact raw samples, analysis/case study and claim-to-evidence mapping only. No private logs/machine paths/shared assets/CV/profile changes.
